offers_products.reason: Sells new and used aircraft and engine parts, plus software (Trax) and shelter/mobility systems.

offers_services.reason: Airframe and component maintenance, repair and overhaul, plus supply chain and government sustainment programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are airlines, OEMs, MROs, cargo companies and governments; no individual buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to commercial airlines, OEMs, MROs and government agencies worldwide.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat parts orders, MRO work and multi-year supply chain and government programs from the same airlines and governments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Aircraft maintenance, repair and parts are needed to keep fleets flying; government programs also steady.

big_ticket.reason: Aircraft parts orders, repair jobs and maintenance programs are routine, frequent purchases, not large one-off buys.

people_delivered.reason: Largest part is parts distribution and MRO relying on hangars, inventory and parts; not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are airlines, OEMs and governments including the US Department of Defense.

asset_heavy.reason: Parts distribution and MRO hangars; leased facilities, inventory-heavy but not fleets or networks; moderate capital needs.

notes: Judgments based on AAR's parts supply, MRO and government segments; recurring-revenue call is moderately uncertain.
